scope: Offline file contracts and synthetic verification layers only. Verified never means every brand/version, online ingestion, retrieval quality or semantic long-term model memory.

status_definitions.verified: Independent fixture/golden, real native readback where a writer exists, canonical archive roundtrip, transaction and bundle/core layers; inspect conformance NOT_RUN per environment
status_definitions.legacy: Historical MemLink variant; tested fixture contract, not a current upstream native claim
status_definitions.experimental: Documented unverified variation; do not rely on for production
status_definitions.unsupported: No supported implementation or verification layer

generic.structure: Recursive *.md, plain text or unique YAML frontmatter; generated notes/*.md includes canonical-v1 and bounded body framing

conversion_rules: frontmatter id/name/title map to canonical; archived remains archived with --all
created/date and updated normalize to UTC; original YAML retained
unknown YAML fields retained as extensions; generated notes preserve canonical fields
dropped_or_unsupported: Application databases, binary attachments, Obsidian/Logseq/Bear semantics
